transcript.content: Hi, welcome in—I'm Dr. Lee. What brings you in to see me today?

Um, hi. I'm mostly just here because... well, my supervisor told me I needed to. I guess I keep leaving my station on the floor. And, like, popping up during meetings when I'm supposed to just stay put. He says it's turning into a safety problem... because I just take off before I even think about it.
Can you tell me whether you've noticed this kind of restlessness and trouble staying seated or focused since you were a kid, or is this something that's really only started recently?

Um... no, it's not a new thing. It's been like this since I was little. 

Like, even back in elementary school, I couldn't really stay in my seat. I'd... talk over the teacher a lot. They were always sending notes home because I'd just blurt stuff out, or... I'd just be wandering around the room when I wasn't supposed to. So, yeah. It's always been like that.
Besides the restlessness and impulsivity, do you also have ongoing trouble staying focused on tasks, following through on details, or frequently losing track of things like keys or assignments?
Um... not really, no. I mean, I don't really lose things that much. And I can focus fine if I actually need to. It's mostly just... the other stuff.

latest_inference.note: Patient denies inattentive symptoms (no difficulty focusing, no losing items), ruling out combined (F90.2) and inattentive (F90.0) ADHD presentations.
